svg.title: Solver time of every backend tuple, Apple M4 Max
svg.desc: Horizontal bars of median solver time on a log scale for every validated build, MPI rank, OpenMP thread, and GPU tuple on Apple M4 Max at 100000 particles per hour, fastest at the top, labelled with the median and the speedup over the serial build. Computational diagnostic of measured execution; no confidence intervals.
